login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your pharmacy account to continue

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noAttention: Nothing needs your attention right now
dashboard.noAttentionHint: When something needs following up, it will appear here on its own
dashboard.deliveryNote: “No reply” is not a failure of ours — the message arrived and the patient did not answer. “Expired before sending” is our own outage, and says nothing about the patient's adherence.
dashboard.deliveryEmpty: No messages were sent in this period

patients.title: Patients
patients.subtitle: {count} patients registered at this pharmacy
patients.adherenceHint: Doses taken as a share of the doses this patient had a fair chance to take, over the last 30 days
patients.adherenceNoDataHint: No doses have been recorded for this patient yet
patients.emptyHint: Register your first patient to start sending medication reminders
patients.noResultsHint: Try a different name or phone number

patient.consentMissingHint: Without recorded consent, no messages will be sent to this patient
patient.noMedicationsHint: Add a medication and its times so reminders can start
patient.noMedicationsHintReadOnly: Ask a pharmacist to record the medication and its times
patient.noDosesHint: Doses will appear here once the schedule starts running
patient.reportedProblemHint: The patient's own words, stored as reported. This is not a confirmation that the dose was taken.

followUps.title: Follow-ups
followUps.subtitle: {count} cases need a pharmacist, most urgent first
followUps.emptyHint: When something needs following up, it will appear here on its own

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every change made in this pharmacy, newest first

immutable.title: This log cannot be edited
immutable.body: No one can change or delete an entry here — not even a pharmacy admin, and not us. The database itself refuses the write, so an entry that has been made stays as it was made.

audit.emptyHint: Entries appear here as soon as anything is changed in this pharmacy
audit.noResultsHint: Try a wider date range, or clear a filter

caseDetail.noMedication: No medication linked to this case
caseDetail.alertsEmpty: No alerts are linked to this case
caseDetail.interventionsEmptyHint: Record the call or the message below, so the next pharmacist sees what has already been tried.
caseDetail.terminal: This case is closed. If the problem comes back, open a new case — this record stays as it is.
caseDetail.recordHint: What you did, and what the patient said. This is the follow-up record.
caseDetail.nextFollowUpHint: Leave it empty to keep the current due date
caseDetail.errorNotFound: This case does not exist in this pharmacy
caseDetail.errorInvalidInput: Some fields are missing or not valid
caseDetail.errorIllegalTransition: A case that is {from} cannot be moved to {to}
caseDetail.errorForbidden: You are not allowed to change follow-up cases

medications.addTitle: Add a medication and its schedule
medications.addSubtitle: The medication and its schedule are saved together, and reminders start immediately
medications.editSubtitle: Any schedule change is recorded as a new revision, and future reminders follow it
medications.name: Medication name
medications.instructionsHint: Written in the language you are reading now; the other language's text is left as it is
medications.modePrnHint: As needed means no times and no reminders — recorded so it stays on the patient's file
medications.timesOfDayHint: 24-hour format, one per row. A repeated time is collapsed into one
medications.daysOfWeekHint: At least one day is required, or the schedule never runs
medications.timeZoneHint: Defaults to the patient's. Changing it moves every future dose.
medications.endDateHint: Optional — leave empty for an ongoing course
medications.lateWindowMinutesHint: Optional — leave empty and it is computed from the gap to the next dose
medications.statusHint: On hold pauses reminders until you resume. Discontinued or completed stops them for good.
medications.reasonHint: Optional — recorded with the new revision in the change log
medications.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this medication and all its schedules and reminders? This cannot be undone.

errors.INVALID_TIMEZONE: Choose a time zone from the list
errors.INVALID_TIME: A time must be in 24-hour form, for example 08:00 or 20:30
errors.TOO_MANY: That is more times than are allowed
errors.END_BEFORE_START: The end date is before the start date
errors.NOT_FOUND: That patient or medication does not exist

messages.title: Message log
messages.subtitle: Every reminder sent and every reply that came back, across all patients
messages.legend: Outlined box = how the delivery went on our side. Filled pill = what the patient said. Two separate facts: a message that arrived with no reply does not mean the dose was taken.
messages.emptyHint: Try widening the date range or removing a filter

patientForm.registerSubtitle: The patient record and their consent are captured in one step
patientForm.editSubtitle: Every change here is written to the change log
patientForm.fullNameHint: Write the name as the patient says it — messages use it to address them
patientForm.phoneHint: Type it as the patient gave it (01001234567); the country code is added for you
patientForm.timeZoneHint: Dose times are read in this zone. Defaults to the pharmacy's.
patientForm.careNotesHint: Optional — anything the team should know: allergies, chronic conditions, circumstances
patientForm.externalRefHint: Optional — the paper file number, or a number from another system
patientForm.statusHint: Paused also stops reminders until you take them off hold
patientForm.consentIntro: Consent is recorded together with the patient, not as a separate chore afterwards.
patientForm.consentAppendNote: Consent is a history: saving here adds a new record and does not change the older one.
patientForm.consentWhatsappHint: No reminder can be sent without this
patientForm.consentWhatsappMissing: Without this consent nothing reaches the patient, and the record stays silent without flagging it
patientForm.consentDataProcessingHint: The baseline consent for holding and following up this patient's data
patientForm.consentEvidenceRefHint: Optional — the signed form's number, or where its photo is stored
patientForm.duplicatePhoneTitle: This number is already registered to another patient
patientForm.duplicatePhoneHint: That is allowed — family members share a handset and both records are saved. Be aware that a reply from it can be attributed to the wrong person, so a second number is better if there is one.

errors.INVALID_PHONE: That is not a valid mobile number — use the local form 01001234567, or include the country code
errors.INVALID_TIMEZONE: Choose a time zone from the list
errors.FORBIDDEN_CONSENT: You are not allowed to record consent — ask the pharmacy manager

reports.title: Operations report
reports.subtitle: Delivery, patient-reported responses and verified outcomes, reported separately over the window you choose

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.caption: This is about our own infrastructure: how many reminders we tried to send and how many actually arrived. Not about the patient.
delivery.rateHint: Doses that arrived, out of all send attempts
delivery.inboundUnrouted: Could not be matched to a patient
delivery.inboundWarning: Some patient messages could not be processed. Those replies are lost, so the response figures below understate the real picture.

responses.title: Patient-reported responses
responses.caption: What the patient said, in their own words. A reply is not proof a dose was taken — it is their account, recorded as given.
responses.scorableHint: Doses that reached the patient with a window to answer, excluding doses our own failures never delivered
responses.rateHint: Out of the doses the patient could answer
responses.adherenceHint: Doses the patient said they took, out of the doses they could answer
responses.noReplyHint: Settled with no answer. Silence is not confirmation, and it is not a missed dose either.
responses.inRateHint: These are the figures in the rate
responses.problemHint: A problem report does not settle the dose for adherence; it opens a follow-up of its own
responses.unattributed: Reply not tied to a dose
responses.inFlightHint: Still inside its response window. There is no evidence yet either way.
responses.patternsHint: Only misses the patient reported themselves, so you can see whether one particular dose is being forgotten.
responses.missedNone: No misses reported in this window
responses.problemsSubtitle: What patients reported, most frequent first
responses.problemsEmpty: No problems reported in this window

verification.title: Verified outcomes
verification.caption: The only verified figures on this page: responses a pharmacist reviewed and either confirmed or corrected. Every other number here is the patient's account.
verification.rateHint: Out of the responses recorded in the window
verification.note: A patient's own report is stored unverified, and a pharmacist's review is recorded beside it as a separate fact.

followUps.title: Follow-up and workload
followUps.caption: Follow-up cases and the team's interventions in the window
followUps.completionHint: Out of the cases opened in the window

workload.title: Interventions per user
workload.empty: No interventions recorded in this window

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Pharmacy details and alert rule thresholds

summary.title: This pharmacy
summary.patientsHint: Every patient file in this pharmacy

profile.title: Pharmacy details
profile.hint: The name and details that appear on everything that goes out to patients.
profile.name: Pharmacy name
profile.timeZoneHint: Every dose, quiet hour and report is calculated in this zone.
profile.quietHint: No reminders are sent between these times. Times are 24-hour, in the pharmacy's own zone.

channels.title: WhatsApp numbers
channels.hint: The numbers reminders are sent from. Read-only here — a number is a routing key, so changing it is a support task.

rules.title: Alert rules
rules.subtitle: {count} rules run against this pharmacy's data
rules.hint: These are the thresholds the alert engine reads. Every change is written to the audit log, and a new version is created — alerts already raised keep pointing at the version that raised them.
rules.dryRunHint: How many alerts this would have raised in the last 30 days.
rules.dryRunResult: {alerts} alerts against {patients} patients in the last 30 days
rules.dryRunClean: No alerts in the last 30 days with these values
rules.dryRunSample: Projected from a sample of {sample} patients, most recently enrolled first
rules.dryRunInvalid: Those values cannot be projected — check the range shown beside each field

ok.RULE_SAVED: Saved. A dry run of the new values gives {alerts} alerts over the last 30 days.
ok.RULE_SAVED_UNPROJECTED: Saved. The dry run could not be completed, so there is no projection for these values yet.

error.title: Nothing was saved.
error.INVALID_INPUT: One of the values is not accepted.
error.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot change pharmacy settings.

field.name: The pharmacy name must be between 2 and 120 characters.
field.timeZone: That is not a time zone the scheduler recognises.
field.defaultLocale: That is not a language this app supports.
field.ruleKey: That rule is not in the catalogue.
field.params: One of the thresholds is outside the range shown beside its field.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: {count} people have access to this pharmacy

invite.title: Add a colleague
invite.hint: If the address already has an account at another pharmacy, it is added here as a second membership rather than duplicated.
invite.passwordHint: Leave empty and the account is created without one, so it cannot sign in until someone sets a password. Fill it in to provision the account now.
invite.platformOnly: Accounts are created by the platform owner. You can change roles and end access below; ask the platform owner to add a new manager or doctor.

users.statusHint: This is the account itself, not this pharmacy's access to it. A suspended or never-activated account cannot sign in at any pharmacy.
users.youHint: You cannot change your own role or deactivate your own account.
users.deactivateConfirm: They will not be able to sign in. Their history and audit trail stay.
users.adminCountWarning: Only one active admin. Demoting or deactivating them is refused until another admin exists.
users.unassignedPatients: {count} patients were added before the pharmacy began recording who added them; they are not counted under any user.
users.emptyHint: Add the first colleague so someone else can sign in
users.footnote: Everyone added here is a colleague at this pharmacy. Deactivating someone ends their access on their next page load — sessions are re-checked on every request, so there is nothing to revoke by hand.

ok.ROLE_CHANGED: Role changed. It takes effect on their next page load.
ok.MEMBER_ACTIVATED: Access restored. They can sign in again.
ok.MEMBER_DEACTIVATED: Access ended. Their history and audit trail are unchanged.
ok.NO_CHANGE: Nothing to change — that was already the setting.

error.title: Nothing was changed.
error.NOT_FOUND: That account is not part of this pharmacy.
error.SELF_ROLE: You cannot change your own role. Ask another admin.
error.SELF_DEACTIVATE: You cannot deactivate your own account. Ask another admin.
error.LAST_ADMIN: This is the last active admin. The pharmacy must always have one, so this was refused.
error.EMAIL_TAKEN: That person is already a user at this pharmacy.
error.INVALID_INPUT: Some of those details are not accepted.

drugPicker.hint: Type the English name — pick a suggestion or just keep typing

admin.title: Operations
admin.subtitle: The machinery behind this pharmacy's reminders, and whether it is still running

good.title: Every background job is running
good.body: All scheduled jobs have reported in within their expected window.

bad.title: Some background jobs have stopped
bad.body: {stale} of {total} jobs are overdue. A job that is overdue sends nothing and logs nothing, so reminders may have stopped going out.

unrouted.title: Patient replies are not reaching a pharmacy
unrouted.body: {count} replies matched no messaging channel. Those patients tapped a button and nobody is seeing it. The usual cause is the channel's phone number id disagreeing with what Meta sends.

sweeps.title: Background jobs
sweeps.subtitle: Each one reports in on a schedule. One that stops reports nothing at all.

queues.title: Queue depth
queues.subtitle: Hints waiting to be picked up. The database, not Redis, holds the real state.

pharmacy.title: This pharmacy
pharmacy.unroutedHint: A patient tapped and the message matched no channel
pharmacy.unprocessedHint: Stored but not yet read — including any STOP
pharmacy.stuckHint: The worker died between contacting WhatsApp and recording the result

failures.title: Recent failed reminders
failures.subtitle: The last ten, newest first
failures.emptyHint: Nothing this pharmacy sent has been rejected by WhatsApp.

channels.title: Sending numbers
channels.subtitle: Read-only. A channel's number is the key Meta's webhook routes by.
channels.emptyHint: Run the bootstrap to create the messaging channel.

platform.subtitle: Every pharmacy on this installation, and the accounts inside them.
